name: Skills page and the agent Skills tab show the seeded skills
description: Opens /skills, opens the preview drawer of a seeded skill (branch-coverage-rubric) from the card grid, follows Open to /skills/<id>, checks its Config tab (editor, Save) and its Versioning tab, then opens the seeded Test Quality Reviewer and checks its Skills tab lists every skill with the enabled count. Read-only: nothing is created, toggled or saved, no model call.

steps.label: click its card (exact: the card's Delete button is named "Delete skill branch-coverage-rubric")
the preview drawer shows the rendered body
let the drawer finish sliding in (agent-browser clicks without waiting for a moving element to settle)
the Config tab has a Save action
the seeded Test Quality Reviewer is listed
a skill bound to the agent is listed
the tab counts the enabled skills out of all five seeded ones
